decisions.reason: The page 23 photo-crop adjustment does not change the background treatment of the designated special pages.
The page 23 photo-crop adjustment does not alter the cover letter's page count, signature support, or overflow-photo handling.
The source requests a localized photo-framing correction, not a change to the full-document layout rules.
The photo-crop request has no effect on font consistency or the unresolved in-text bolding issue.
Changing the framing of a page 23 photograph does not modify the Blue Mesa brand identity or required brand elements.
The page 23 photograph adjustment does not affect inclusion or placement of the organization chart.
The request to zoom out within an existing photo frame does not change the maximum page count or spacing policy.
The visual correction does not change Canva access, ownership, or asset-policy requirements.
The photo-framing change is unrelated to whether proposal hyperlinks remain functional.
The page 23 photo-crop request does not alter any table content, source, structure, or integration rule.
The photograph adjustment does not affect the biography count, source, affiliation, or population method.
The source changes only the framing of an existing photograph and does not add, remove, or resolve any RFQ section content.
